title: Work heading is 'Work Summary' on Estimate and 'Work Performed' on Invoice
preconditions:
1. You are signed in to ShopView.
2. You can generate an Estimate and an Invoice for work orders that have work lines.
steps:
1. Generate an Estimate and read the work section heading.
2. Generate an Invoice and read the work section heading.
expected:
1. On the Estimate the work section heading reads exactly "Work Summary".
2. On the Invoice the same section heading reads exactly "Work Performed".

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8218 and story SV-9144 (Story 5, Work Section) and the Invoice UI Refresh specification version 39, section S5-R1, read on 25 August 2026.

title: Work line numbers are sequential and zero-padded to two digits
preconditions:
1. You are signed in to ShopView.
2. You can reach a work order with several work lines, and (ideally) one with 100 or more lines.
steps:
1. Generate a document for a work order with multiple lines; read the line numbers.
2. If available, generate a document for a work order with 100 or more lines; read the line numbers.
expected:
1. Line numbers are sequential with no gaps.
2. Lines 1 to 99 are zero-padded to two digits: 01, 02 ... 10, 11.
3. When the document has 100 or more lines, lines 1-99 still show two digits and lines 100 and above show three digits (100, 101 ...).

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8218 and story SV-9144 (Story 5, Work Section) and the Invoice UI Refresh specification version 39, section S5-R2, read on 25 August 2026.

title: Each work line shows name, and description and scope-of-work note when present
preconditions:
1. You are signed in to ShopView.
2. A work order has a line with a name, a description, and a scope-of-work note; and another line with a name only.
steps:
1. Generate the document.
2. Read the line that has a description and a scope-of-work note.
3. Read the line that has a name only.
expected:
1. Each work line shows its name.
2. A line shows its description when a description is present.
3. A line shows its scope-of-work note when a scope-of-work note is present (shown below the description).
4. A line with no description and no scope-of-work note shows just its name (no empty rows).

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8218 and story SV-9144 (Story 5, Work Section) and the Invoice UI Refresh specification version 39, sections S5-R3, S5-R4 and S5-R5, read on 25 August 2026.

title: Invoice Details settings show or hide the per-entry figures
preconditions:
1. You are signed in to ShopView.
2. You can change the document settings under Administration > Invoice Details for a shop, and generate a document for that shop.
steps:
1. Under Administration > Invoice Details, turn each of "Labor hours", "Labor rate", "Labor price", "Part quantity", "Part price" on, generate a document, and read a work line.
2. Turn each setting off, generate again, and read the same line.
expected:
1. When "Labor hours", "Labor rate", "Labor price", "Part quantity" and "Part price" are on, each figure shows on its labor/part entry.
2. Turning a setting off hides its per-entry figure.
3. Turning "Labor price" off also hides the line footer's "Labor" figure; turning "Part price" off also hides the line footer's "Parts" figure.
4. The itemized labor and parts entries themselves are never collapsed or hidden by any setting; "Line total" and the financial summary always show their amounts.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8218 and story SV-9144 (Story 5, Work Section) and the Invoice UI Refresh specification version 39, section S5-R7, read on 25 August 2026.

title: Line-level fee shows as a plain amount; discount shows in parentheses
preconditions:
1. You are signed in to ShopView.
2. A work order has a line with a line-level fee and a line with a line-level discount.
steps:
1. Generate the document.
2. Read the line that has a line-level fee.
3. Read the line that has a line-level discount.
expected:
1. A fee that applies to a single labor or parts line is shown with that line as a plain amount.
2. A discount that applies to a single line is shown with that line in parentheses (the accounting convention for a subtraction).
3. The parentheses are required wording, not styling.

---

title: Line footer shows Labor, Parts and Line total with the divider rule
preconditions:
1. You are signed in to ShopView.
2. You can set "Summarize labor total" and "Summarize parts total" under Administration > Invoice Details, and reach lines with and without visible Labor/Parts figures.
steps:
1. With both summarize settings on, generate a document and read a line footer that has Labor and Parts amounts.
2. Turn the summarize settings off and read the footer again.
3. Read a footer on a line where neither a Labor nor a Parts figure is visible.
expected:
1. Each work line has a footer with figures labeled exactly "Labor", "Parts", and "Line total".
2. The Labor and Parts figures are that line's own totals after its line-level fees and discounts; "Line total" is their sum.
3. A "Labor" or "Parts" footer figure shows only when its summarize setting is on; it is hidden when that setting is off, when its value is $0.00, or when its matching price setting is off (a negative value is shown with its sign).
4. The vertical divider before "Line total" shows only when at least one Labor or Parts figure is visible; when neither is, "Line total" stands alone with no divider.
5. "Line total" always shows, appears once per line, and shows even when it reads $0.00.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8218 and story SV-9144 (Story 5, Work Section) and the Invoice UI Refresh specification version 39, sections S5-R7, S5-R9 and S5-R10, read on 25 August 2026.
